     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→Add functionality to the merge conflicts preview dialog (`ConflictDetailsDialog`) that allows users to selectively exclude files from staging by clicking to toggle individual conflict cards on/off. This enables users reviewing conflicts before staging to disable specific files (e.g., CSS files they don't want to commit) so only enabled conflicts proceed to "Stage with AI Merge".
